items.text: Config Parsers and Config Parser Tests change together: `parseConfig` (source/cli/src/io/config-parser.ts) and `config-parser` (source/cli/tests/unit/io/config-parser.test.ts) were touched in the same commit 15 times — 15 of 22 for one, 15 of 23 for the other. The architecture already connects them.

BuildContextCommand and OwnerCommand change together: `contextAction` (source/cli/src/cli/build-context.ts) and `registerOwnerCommand` (source/cli/src/cli/owner.ts) were touched in the same commit 10 times — 10 of 20 for one, 10 of 19 for the other. The architecture already connects them. 1 other pair of declarations move with them; the strongest one is quoted here, and the rest are not counted as extra evidence.
